remarks: Beautifully renovated condo in Greenwich Towers! This unit has a spacious and bright open floor plan. Gorgeous new gourmet kitchen with quartz counter tops and professional stainless appliances. Open and expansive Living/Dining Area. Fabulous office with built ins. The bathrooms have been renovated with sleek and stylish finishes.The lower level Primary Bedroom has a Private Terrace. Full size washer/dryer in unit.This classic Art Deco Building has a Roof Top Deck with amazing views of LI Sound and Manhattan Skyline. Serene Garden Courtyard too! 1 assigned garage space and 1 deeded outdoor space. Storage unit, Heat and Water included. Convenient location close to Greenwich Ave., shops. restaurants and train. Move right in and enjoy!! Must have excellent credit
